1244|245cbd71.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
1244|245cbd71.text:
The roots and ferns speak well of you, small one. Although I have many names, I answer to few. But you may call me Rethiel.

And you must harken... for these lands weep from festered wounds, and I would charge you to heal them.

1480|4d61ac25.name: Caitlin Grassman
1480|4d61ac25.text: Alchemy can help so many people! It's my life's passion.

2094|28b1f157.name: James Halloran
2094|28b1f157.text: Greetings, $c. I'm in a bit of a pinch right now, running very low on hides.

2104|fe329646.name: Captain Stoutfist
2104|fe329646.text: Menethil Harbor enjoys a bit of peace these days, thanks to the mountaineers.  But we must be ever watchful of new threats from our enemies.

5694|f9a7a324.name: High Sorcerer Andromath
5694|f9a7a324.text: The flow of magic is unpredictable and chaotic, of late. What, I wonder, could be the cause of this?

115-progress.name: Marshal Marris
115-progress.text: How goes your conflict with the shadowcasters?  Did you find the midnight orbs?
115-progress.title: Shadow Magic

122-progress.name: Verner Osgood
122-progress.text: I know that greedy Argus will send someone to collect his scales if I don't give them to him soon.  Have you found those scales yet?
122-progress.title: Underbelly Scales

126-progress.name: Verner Osgood
126-progress.text: Yowler is a dangerous creature, $N.  If you're not ready for him, I understand.
126-progress.title: Howling in the Hills

133-progress.name: Abercrombie
133-progress.text: I think I hear a pack of Ghouls scurrying around the back of the house - I better put that effigy up quick!  Did you get those Ghoul Ribs for me?
133-progress.title: Ghoulish Effigy

134-progress.name: Abercrombie
134-progress.text: Do you have my crate?  If so, then please...give it to me quickly!
134-progress.title: Ogre Thieves

156-progress.name: Tavernkeep Smitts
156-progress.text: Hi, $N.  Do you have those rot blossoms for me yet?
156-progress.title: Gather Rot Blossoms

159-progress.name: Abercrombie
159-progress.text: I need that Zombie Juice to keep me warm on these cold, dark nights.  Did you get it for me?
159-progress.title: Juice Delivery

160-progress.name: Lord Ello Ebonlocke
160-progress.text:
Abercrombie...?  I don't know a person of that name.  You say you have a letter for me from this Abercrombie fellow?

Well let's have it then...
160-progress.title: Note to the Mayor

180-progress.name: Magistrate Solomon
180-progress.text: What news do you bring before the Court?
180-progress.title: WANTED: Lieutenant Fangore

19-progress.name: Marshal Marris
19-progress.text: Orc pressure from Blackrock is still tense.  But have you at least rid us of Tharil'zun?
19-progress.title: Tharil'zun

248-progress.name: An Empty Jar
248-progress.text: This jar once held a foul-smelling liquor, but now lies empty and forgotten on a pair of barrels.
248-progress.title: Looking Further

251-progress.name: Sirra Von'Indi
251-progress.text: A note from Abercrombie the hermit, eh?  I don't know him, though if he lives out at the graveyard then I do know his brains have rotted out!
251-progress.title: Translate Abercrombie's Note

252-progress.name: Lord Ello Ebonlocke
252-progress.text: Ah, is the note translated?  Please, let me see it...
252-progress.title: Translation to Ello

253-progress.name: Lord Ello Ebonlocke
253-progress.text: Have you yet found Eliza's grave?  Do you have the Embalmer's heart?
253-progress.title: Bride of the Embalmer

269-progress.name: Bishop Farthing
269-progress.text: Rest, brother.  I can tell you have traveled far, and you bear a heavy burden.  Can you tell me what casts that dark shadow over you?
269-progress.title: Seeking Wisdom

277-progress.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
277-progress.text: Do you have the Gnolls' tools for fire?
277-progress.title: Fire Taboo

324-progress.name: Glorin Steelbrow
324-progress.text: Did you find the lightforge iron you need?
324-progress.title: The Lost Ingots

337-progress.name: Milton Sheaf
337-progress.text: Ooh!  What's that old book you have there?  Can I see it??
337-progress.title: An Old History Book

346-progress.name: Brother Kristoff
346-progress.text: Were you able to find the book?
346-progress.title: Return to Kristoff

347-progress.name: Brother Paxton
347-progress.text: Do you have the Rethban Ore?
347-progress.title: Rethban Ore

471-progress.name: James Halloran
471-progress.text:
My apprentice is like a son to me. It's going to be hard for him to live his life with only one leg.

Ah, $N, how goes it?  Do you have my skins?
471-progress.title: Apprentice's Duties

579-progress.name: Donyal Tovald
579-progress.text: King Anduin has placed great importance on learning, and thus has provided funds for making copies of various tomes and writings available to the public. It's very simple. You bring me a library scrip, and I can give you a copy of one of the available books.
579-progress.title: Stormwind Library

7791-progress.name: Clavicus Knavingham
7791-progress.text:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by Stormwind for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7791-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

91-progress.name: Bailiff Conacher
91-progress.text: Turn in 10 Shadowhide Pendants to me, and you shall be rewarded.
91-progress.title: Solomon's Law

92489-accept.name: High Sorcerer Andromath
92489-accept.text:
The Kirin Tor have long been allies of the Alliance. With the destruction of their city at the hands of the arch demon Archimonde, the once proud city of mages has now become reclusive and distrusting of outsiders.

In recent years they have begun reconstruction efforts to bring the city of Dalaran back to its former glory. However, reports show they are struggling to contain an outbreak of wayward arcane energies.

We must help them disperse these attacks lest we lose one of our most powerful allies.
92489-accept.title: Power Overwhelming

94-progress.name: Old Lion Statue
94-progress.text:
This Lion Statue has sat here for decades, and keeps a lonely watch over the infamous Tower of Ilgalar.

There is a depression at the base of the statue, where a gem or glyph might be set...
94-progress.title: A Watchful Eye

95647-accept.name: Caitlin Grassman
95647-accept.text:
My husband, Ardin, has a rare gift for sensing nature. He'll scale any peak to gather the herbs and flowers I need for my alchemy, keeping our shelves and pantry stocked.

But I fear he's wandered into trouble. An excavation crew passed through seeking supplies. They spoke, among other things, of towering grasses unlike anything they'd ever seen. Those were what he told me he had to go see for himself. He's been gone too long!

If you learn anything of him, I'd be grateful.
95647-accept.title: Lost in the Thicket Things

95772-accept.name: Dorin Songblade
95772-accept.text:
Me brother tried draggin' me off tae the Wetlands with some diggin' crew out o' Loch Modan. Said they were headin' into hills no dwarf's ever set boot in for some sort o' excavation.

Aye, I'd 'ave gone, if I wasn't already behind on this pile o' girdles I've got to refit.

Daewyn normally writes after he sends off, though. Haven't heard a thing, gives me a strange feelin' this time.

If yer marchin' that way, mind checking in on me brother?
95772-accept.title: Songblade Search

95999-complete.name: Magistrate Solomon
95999-complete.text: Excellent work, $N! Incinerator Gar'im was preparing to bolster the defenses at Stonewatch Keep. With this victory, we may yet succeed in reclaiming the keep!
95999-complete.title: WANTED: Incinerator Gar'im

98072-accept.name: James Halloran
98072-accept.text:
You're quite the go-getter! I have just one more favor to ask, if you're up for something a bit more dangerous.

The crocolisk trade is steady money, but they're small fish compared to what whelp scales will bring. Folks will pay top dollar for a sack of those.

Crocs of the sky, I call 'em! There's no way my apprentice could get them--but it seems right up your alley!

You'll find whelps far to the east, along the Green Belt. But be careful, there's nasty orcs in those hills!
98072-accept.title: Crocs of the Sky

98208-complete.name: Sylessa Duskwhisper
98208-complete.text:
It has survived! Oh, Elune be praised!

A thousand thanks, $N. If you are willing, I do have one more favor to ask of you...
98208-complete.title: Bloom of the Heavens

98208-progress.name: Sylessa Duskwhisper
98208-progress.text: Have you been to the wreckage? It is a most somber sight.
98208-progress.title: Bloom of the Heavens

98209-accept.name: Sylessa Duskwhisper
98209-accept.text:
Would you please deliver Nord'el to elder Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine?

The boat from here should be able to get you there swiftly.

I apologize for the request, I truly do. I remain fatigued from my journey here--and from fleeing those murloc devils when I first attempted to retrieve the sacred bloom!
98209-accept.title: Bloom of the Heavens

98221-accept.name: Captain Stoutfist
98221-accept.text:
In the Second War the Dragonmaw built a fleet where we now stand, intending to take Hillsbrad. They nearly succeeded!

They were routed by the red dragons, left to mere stragglers deep in the mountains. However, there has been a surge in activity in their encampment northeast of Menethil.

Dun Algaz is proof that they intend to march to war once again and retake this land. Find their attack plans, take note of any critical information, and destroy them. We need to know where they will strike next!
98221-accept.title: From the Ashes

98387-progress.name: Marshal Marris
98387-progress.text: Most of what you find will have been raided from Lakeshire anyway. It will do me good to know our people will thrive while the orcs wither.
98387-progress.title: Blackrock Blockade

98815-accept.name: James Halloran
98815-accept.text:
The Highlands are host to ruins of some sort, secrets now being explored by an expedition team. What I know is that they've got their own wildlife and beasts lurking in that mountain marshland. How about you take a foray in there with some well-equipped friends, and we work a trade?

I don't care if they're hiding, I want their hides! Bring me the skins from four of the Thicket Raptors, I'll have a trade worked out for you to make it worth it.
98815-accept.title: Highland Hides

99267-complete.name: Night Watch Guard
99267-complete.text:
The deceased Night Watchman lying before you is covered in deep gashes and cuts. It's clear to see that he was mauled by some sort of large beast.

You notice that the corpse still has an unlit torch in his hand. You must not have taken it earlier after all.

You reach down and pry it from his stiff fingers. This could be useful in your travels through Duskwood and beyond to reveal things hidden by darkness.
99267-complete.title: An Unfortunate End
